name: Open a card's board
responsibility: Opens the board one level down from a double-clicked card when its drill-down leads somewhere, unless the reader moved on before the answer came
description: Asks the one drill-down reading where the card's link leads, once. A target that leads nowhere opens nothing: the inspector beside the picture reads the same target and says why.

outgoing.label: where the double-click leads, asked once
the board and variant to open, once read
